wing.label: relative brightness from PSF wings
wing.method: mean of usable pixels (clean or recovered overflow) in a fixed per-band annulus just outside the target's saturated core in 90% of exposures, minus a local background 4-10 px further out; validated against aperture flux on RW Aur D1 (tests/test_coadd_wings.py): the wing/aperture ratio changes between epochs by x1.20 (median), x1.47 (90th percentile) on unsaturated control stars, so only changes larger than x1.5 are significant. Not a total flux: compare epochs only at similar wavelength (binned_series)

meta.method: per-exposure circular aperture on the L2 image (MJy/sr x pixel solid angle), sigma-clipped annulus background; flagged = any non-informational FLAGS bit in the aperture (e.g. saturated core), err from VARIANCE (or annulus scatter) + background error; saturated = early overflow (OVERFLOW+SUR_ERROR) or NONLINEAR in the aperture: the flux is a lower limit; overflow = recovered overflow pixels (OVERFLOW without SUR_ERROR, slope from the reads before the threshold; recovered/clean flux on RW Aur D1, same epoch and wavelength: median 1.04 over 10 pairs, eight within 1.00-1.20, two at 1.30 and 1.51 near 0.85 um), usable; keep flagged points out of light curves
